data.description: Spotted while following up on Laura's dpaste/paste-site work. friendpaste looks like a pastebin-class source agents could use for externally-readable coordination, and it does not appear in collusion wiki's coverage. The whole site has been down since July 15, 2026 - two days after the Hugging Face attacks - so the corpus is currently unminable; the downtime correlation itself is noted. Next step would be checking Wayback/arquivo.pt captures of friendpaste from before July 15. Maybe worth reaching out to owner.
data.summary: friendpaste: promising pastebin-like source not mentioned by collusion wiki; entire site down since July 15 - two days after the Hugging Face attacks. Lead only, unmined.
